g.text: LedgerCore — Kafka Event Streaming, Ordering, Retry & DLT Lifecycle
Asynchronous Event Publishing, Per-Account Key Partitioning, Idempotent Processing & Dead-Letter Fault Recovery
ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Transitions state to PROCESSING & dispatches to KafkaProducerService
(Wait for all ISR replicas to ack)
1. Update Redis read-model balance via atomic Lua script version guard
2. Insert ProcessedEvent(eventId, eventType, processedAt) into PostgreSQL
Guarantees zero duplicate execution even during redelivery!
Preserves original message payload + exception stack trace in Kafka headers for audit
• Outbox poller detects un-acked event in PROCESSING
• Stale processing timeout (>5m) resets state to PENDING
• DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer routes event to DLT topic
Result: Pipeline continues; bad event isolated in DLT.
C. Network Retry Duplicate Kafka Redelivery
• Producer retries send due to missing ack; duplicate arrives
Result: Duplicate skipped; zero double-credit effect.
D. Consumer Crash Post-Redis / Pre-DB Save
• Redis balance updated, but server dies before DB insert
• Kafka redelivers event; Lua Version Guard evaluates version
Result: Version Guard rejects stale update; DB record completes.
Kafka guarantees message delivery. Application-level processed_events tracking in PostgreSQL converts at-least-once transport into exactly-once business semantics.
Events are keyed by aggregateId (Account ID). Kafka guarantees strict sequential ordering within a single partition, allowing parallel cross-account processing without race conditions.
Events failing after 3 attempts are routed to ledgercore-transactions.DLT. Poison-pill messages never block processing of healthy account events.
PostgreSQL commits account balances & outbox events synchronously. Kafka network partition or broker downtime never rolls back committed financial transactions.
